name: Relevance
description: Measures how well the generated continuation relates to the provided context and interesting fact. A high score indicates that the continuation is on-topic and relevant to the conversation.
scale: Scored on a scale of 1-5, with 1 being not relevant and 5 being highly relevant.

name: Coherence
description: Evaluates the logical flow and organization of the generated continuation. A high score indicates that the continuation is well-structured, easy to follow, and maintains a consistent theme throughout.
scale: Scored on a scale of 1-5, with 1 being incoherent and 5 being highly coherent.

name: Fluency
description: Assesses the grammatical correctness and readability of the generated continuation. A high score indicates that the continuation is grammatically correct, well-written, and easy to understand.
scale: Scored on a scale of 1-5, with 1 being not fluent and 5 being highly fluent.

name: Engagement
description: Measures how interesting and engaging the generated continuation is. A high score indicates that the continuation is captivating, informative, and encourages further conversation.
scale: Scored on a scale of 1-5, with 1 being not engaging and 5 being highly engaging.

name: Factual Accuracy
description: Evaluates the correctness of any factual information presented in the generated continuation. A high score indicates that the continuation is accurate and reliable.
scale: Scored on a scale of 1-5, with 1 being factually inaccurate and 5 being highly accurate.
